content.text: {"issues":[{"where":"Phase 1 and Question 3 — false-positive rate measure","problem":"Phase 1 validation and Question 3 both rely on normal-traffic archives alone; a reconstruction-error distribution or false-positive rate computed only on normal traffic confirms the model memorises normality but cannot show it detects anything, because no anomalies are present to measure against.","fix":"Move the scripted fault injection from Phase 2 into Phase 1 so that the baseline validation report includes both false-positive rate on normal traffic and detection rate on at least a small set of labelled bench faults."},{"where":"Question 1 — 'technician consensus labels on scripted faults'","problem":"The plan assigns fault scripting to university staff in Phase 2, so technician consensus labels do not exist at the time Question 1 is posed as a measurable outcome; no party's records show a labelling or consensus protocol that could be ready by M6.","fix":"Clarify in the plan that Question 1 is evaluated in Phase 2 after bench faults are scripted and labelled, or specify that ArmaturaSec engineers provide the consensus labelling as part of Phase 2 output."}],"unconfirmed":["Research staff or postgraduate student part-time for implementation and evaluation"]}
